plan.summary: Ensure secure handling of YAML files to prevent code execution vulnerabilities.
error_handling: FileNotFoundError -> log error and raise exception; yaml.YAMLError -> return error response to user
acceptance_criteria: Filename must pass validation against allowed extensions and paths.
YAML loading must succeed without exceptions.
Content must not include executable code.

plan.summary: Insecure XML parsing can lead to XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerabilities.
error_handling: ParseError -> log error and return null
acceptance_criteria: No external entities are processed during XML parsing
Input does not exceed configured size limits
XML structure conforms to defined schemas where applicable

plan.summary: User profile information should be securely handled to prevent exposure or injection attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Input must be less than the maximum allowed length.
Validate that input matches expected format.
Check user authentication before returning profile data.

plan.summary: Avoid unsafe deserialization from user input to prevent remote code execution.

error_handling.Exception: log error and return 500 Internal Server Error

acceptance_criteria: No untrusted input can be passed to deserialization functions.
Responses must not include internal state information.

plan.summary: Validate URLs for redirection to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Only URLs matching the policy are redirected.
Invalid URLs return an appropriate error response.
Redirect behavior is logged for audit purposes.
